# Wired Geese

Wired Geese is Alex Gusev's public software-making practice. The human website is maintained in English (`en`), Russian (`ru`), and Spanish (`es`).

All dated Journal articles are authored in Markdown. Localized `.html` URLs are SSR presentations for people. The English `.md` URL is the sole direct representation for AI agents; Russian and Spanish Markdown sources are not published as agent URLs.
